_status: FROZEN v2.0 2026-10-05 - DSR iteration 2 (relevance check). Identical to v1.1 except maturity.relevance. v1.1 remains in config/ and stays reproducible.

unit_text_mode._why: How an obligation unit is embedded for Relatedness. 'keywords' = action + object + the unit's annotated keywords. Chosen 2026-10-05: best separation on the primary negative set, improvement confirmed on the held-out set (which still FAILED the pre-set bar narrowly - reported as such).

relatedness_floor_enabled._why: Method of record = true. A run with false is a declared sensitivity check only, never the reported result.

relatedness_floor._why: Stage 0 gate. Pairs whose best catalog-row cosine is below this are EXCLUDED, not scored low. Value is per embedder because cosine scales differ between models.

coverage_mode._why: 'ramp' = method of record (chosen 2026-10-05 by reasoning: removes the 0/1 cliff that flipped attributes on small text changes, while keeping Coverage's meaning as 'fraction of attributes addressed'). 'threshold' kept only as a declared sensitivity run.

coverage_ramp._why: Per-attribute score = 0 at/below low, 1 at/above high, linear between. Coverage = mean over attributes. Values are a-priori drafts: low ~ where clearly-unrelated text sits, high ~ where clear matches sit. Per embedder because cosine scales differ.

coverage_threshold._why: An attribute counts as addressed by the control if its best cosine against any catalog leaf row reaches this value.

alignment_weights._why: Stage 1 weighted sum. If a measure is not applicable for a pair (e.g. Strength Match for a 'conditional' unit), its weight is dropped and the rest are re-normalised.
alignment_weights._v1_1_why: 2026-10-05, triggered by the pre-planned non-redundancy check: Strength Match = 1.000 on all 29 pairs where it applies, so its correlation with any measure is undefined and the named cut test could not run. It is not redundant but UNINFORMATIVE: it added a constant 0.15 to every applicable Alignment and changed no ranking. Weight set to 0 (still computed and reported). Remaining weights re-normalise: Coverage 0.35/0.85, Relatedness 0.25/0.85, Directionality 0.25/0.85.

modality_strength._why: Strength the clause DEMANDS. null = not applicable (unit is not a plain duty).

maturity._why: Stage 2 prose-feature heuristics (decision 3, 2026-07-23: deterministic only, no LLM).
maturity._negation_cues_why: Narrowed 2026-10-05 when the cap was added: a cap makes false positives costly, so only phrases that unambiguously mean 'not done' are kept ('will be', 'future', 'todo', 'not yet' removed - e.g. 'logs will be retained' describes a built control). No FleetTrack result changed: only 'not implemented' and 'known gap' had ever matched.
maturity._declared_gap_cap_why: A by-component whose text declares the control not done is capped at this score: well-written prose about a gap is not evidence of realization. Above 0 so a documented gap stays distinguishable from a control the SSP never mentions (absent = 0). Applied before the inheritance discount.
maturity._horizontal_rule_why: DECIDED 2026-10-05 (max): one component that properly implements a statement satisfies it; others are usually supporting. Cost: a weak component can hide behind a strong one. In FleetTrack it only affects ac-3 and sa-9.
maturity._vertical_rule_why: DECIDED 2026-10-05 (mean, na excluded, absent=0): Realization measures DEGREE. min (weakest link) would score ac-2 as 0 because 15 of 18 rows are absent, collapsing Realization to complete/not. mean keeps ac-2 at 0.129 = 3 of 18 parts, done well.
maturity._inheritance_discount_why: x 0.5 kept: inherited (parent-level) text is real but weaker evidence (A3, 2026-08-06); half credit is the most neutral defensible value. Not changed after seeing it halves 8 of 20 FleetTrack controls, to avoid a results-driven choice. Revisit-if from decisions.md 2026-08-06 still applies.

relevance._why: Iteration 2, decided 2026-10-05 BEFORE any relevance score was computed. Targets v1 H3/H4 failures: Maturity never checked whether a text is ABOUT the control it is attached to. Each by-component score is multiplied by a 0-1 ramp of cosine(by-component text, the catalog row it is attached to, incl. parent stem). Ramp values reuse the Coverage ramp (no new constants): the floor check put unrelated text near 0.24-0.29 and real matches near 0.50. Order: features -> gap cap -> x relevance -> horizontal max -> inheritance discount -> vertical mean. Realization still never reads the CLAUSE, so the Alignment/Realization separation holds.

relatedness_rollup._why: DECIDED 2026-10-05 (max = best-matching catalog row). The top-2 mean was tested in the Relatedness diagnostic and did not help (6/19 units with negative margin vs 5/19 for max).
